messages:
sara: Quick heads-up 5 I'm moving my official homebase from California (US) -> Dublin (IE). Target effective date 2026-04-15. What's the process for WFH stipend, benefits transfer, and payroll cutover?

jordan: Is this permanent or a temporary remote stint? Permanent moves have different payroll/tax/benefits flows.

sara: Permanent. Continuing on the same team, fully remote.

raj: Thanks for flagging, @sara. High-level: (1) submit Homebase Change form with ID/bank docs, (2) finance runs a tax-nexus scan for IE, (3) payroll schedules the cutover & possible stipend proration, (4) benefits team does enrollment change with a typical 30-day offset.

maria: Please upload Irish tax ID and proof of address via https://redwood.internal/hr/homebase-change at least 10 business days before the desired cutover to avoid gaps.

payroll-bot: Reminder: missing bank or tax docs will delay cutover. See checklist: ID, proof of address, local bank (IBAN), and preferred stipend date.

raj: On the WFH stipend: policy is to prorate in the month of transition by days unless you request aligning to our payroll cadence (1st or 15th). If you pick alignment we'll change your stipend payment date which involves a payroll schedule change request.

maria: Benefits detail: you'll remain on US medical plan until the benefits termination date we set. Ireland benefits enrollment can begin after eligibility is validated; there9s usually a 30-day waiting period for non-local hires/moves. We'll confirm exact timing after we get docs.

sara: Timeline question: I plan to move 2026-04-10 and want homebase effective 2026-04-15. If I submit everything by 2026-04-01 is that enough?

maria: If docs are uploaded by 2026-04-01 we can target 2026-04-15 cutover, pending bank IBAN verification and local tax ID validation. If anything is missing we may have to delay to next payroll cycle.

raj: I'll run the tax-nexus scan for Ireland now and circle back by EOD tomorrow. If an entity/legal review is required we'll add legal and finance to the loop.

jordan: Also note: infra SSO/VPN geo restrictions. Eng infra needs the updated homebase to avoid MFA geo blocks. @sara please add the infra-access request so we can whitelist your new geolocation prior to your first login from IE.

maria: Copying the required fields you should include in the Homebase Change form for convenience:

" + "``
name: sara
current_country: USA
new_country: IRELAND
effective_date: 2026-04-15
local_tax_id: (uploaded document)
local_bank_details: (IBAN uploaded)
preferred_stipend_date: 15th or prorated
``

" + "maria: If you want stipend aligned to a full-month schedule pick 1st or 15th. Otherwise we'll prorate April based on days in each country.

sara: Thanks 5 I'll upload docs today and pick the 15th to keep the stipend stable. Tagging @raj @jordan for follow-ups.

payroll-bot: Next steps queued: (1) sara uploads form + docs, (2) finance performs nexus check, (3) payroll schedules cutover and validates payment method, (4) benefits processes enrollment change. Status updates will post here. :thumbsup: 

raj: FYI to ops: if multiple folks move to a new country within a 30-day window we batch nexus/legal checks to avoid duplicate reviews.

jordan: I'll reserve 30 mins tomorrow to help with the infra whitelist and to make sure SSO exceptions are applied before your first IE login.

sara: Form submitted (uploaded tax ID + IBAN). Posting confirmation: 2026-03-29T11:22Z. I'll ping if anything else is requested. :)
